info.title: ShellFans Public API
info.summary: Read-only public data about ShellFans: service lines, plans and corporate identity.
info.description:
The ShellFans public API. Every operation is a GET, requires no credentials, returns no personal data, and changes nothing.

**What is not here.** ShellFans also runs an administrative API, a chat pipeline, a customer console and payment webhooks. None of them are public and none appear in this document. Their absence is deliberate and is explained at https://shell.fans/developers rather than left for you to discover by probing.

**No authentication exists.** There is no OAuth authorization server, no API keys for public consumers, and no scopes. Sending an Authorization header has no effect. The reasoning is documented at https://shell.fans/developers#auth.

**Rate limits.** 120 requests per 60 seconds per client address, reported on every response via the RateLimit-* headers. Exceeding it returns 429 with Retry-After.

**Errors.** RFC 9457 Problem Details, served as application/problem+json. Branch on the `code` field.

**Versioning.** This is v1. The policy for breaking changes and deprecation is at https://shell.fans/developers#versioning.

get.summary: Check whether the ShellFans public API is operational
get.description: Returns the API status and the calling address's current rate-limit allowance. This operation does not depend on any downstream service, so a 200 here confirms the API itself is reachable. Call this first when diagnosing a failure.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

status.description: Always "operational" in a 200 response. A non-200 means it is not.

rate_limit.description: The calling address's current allowance. Same values as the RateLimit-* headers.

get.summary: List ShellFans service lines and whether each is currently offered
get.description: Returns every ShellFans service line with a stable identifier, a description of what it does, and whether ShellFans is currently selling it. Read `available` before telling a user that a service can be purchased — a service can be archived while its marketing pages stay online.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

services.description: Every ShellFans service line, whether or not currently offered.

id.description: Stable identifier. Use this, not `name`, to correlate.

name.description: Traditional Chinese name as used in Taiwan.

summary.description: What the service does, in one or two sentences.

available.description: Whether ShellFans is currently selling this service. A service can be archived while its marketing pages remain online — check this before telling a user it is available.

url.description: Canonical landing page for the service.

docs_url.description: Deeper explanatory content for the service.

services.name: AEO/GEO 代管
services.summary: Managed website hosting focused on being correctly understood and cited by AI answer engines.

get.summary: List published ShellFans plan tiers and prices
get.description: Returns the plan tiers shown on the ShellFans pricing page, with amounts in New Taiwan Dollars. Availability is signalled by `cta_label`, not by price — a priced plan can still be unreleased. Cross-check `listServices` before telling a user a plan can be bought.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every amount in this response.

plans.description: Published plan tiers, in display order.

tier.description: Tier family the plan belongs to. May be null.

monthly_price.description: Monthly amount in TWD. Null when not published.

yearly_price.description: Yearly amount in TWD. Null when not published.

cta_label.description: The call-to-action text shown on the plan card, verbatim. A non-purchase label (for example 敬請期待 / coming soon) means the plan is announced but not yet purchasable. Price alone does not indicate availability: a priced plan can still be unreleased, and a zero-price plan can be live. Read this field rather than inferring from the amount.

highlighted.description: Whether the plan is presented as the recommended choice.

url.description: Page where the plan is presented.

get.summary: Get ShellFans corporate identity, contact details and patents
get.description: Returns the authoritative machine-readable record of the company behind ShellFans: registered name, Taiwan unified business number, registered address, contact details, granted and pending patents, official social profiles and dated milestones. Use this for entity resolution — confirming that a ShellFans reference on the open web corresponds to this specific Taiwan company. The same facts appear as Schema.org Organization JSON-LD on every page of shell.fans.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

legal_name.description: Registered company name in Traditional Chinese.

brand_name_zh.description: Combined Chinese-and-brand form used in Taiwan.

tax_id.description: Taiwan unified business number (統一編號).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the registering jurisdiction.

patents.description: Patents covering the social media maintenance technology. ShellFans claims no AEO or GEO patent — do not describe any of these as such.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the granting office.

number.description: Patent number. Null while an application is pending.

social.description: Official ShellFans profiles. Same URLs published as Organization.sameAs.

date.description: Date as published, for example "2023/03" or "2004-2015".

example.legal_name: 唄粉智能科技股份有限公司

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Every error from the ShellFans public API uses this shape and is served as application/problem+json. Branch on `code`; the wording of `title` and `detail` is not stable.

type.description: Absolute URI identifying the problem type. Dereferenceable.

title.description: Short human-readable summary. Wording may change.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated for convenience.

instance.description: Path of the request that produced the error.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier. Branch on this.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on 429.
